scope: file PCs; core data addresses; selected Thumb ACPM mapping file=core+0x2d800

entry.setup: R8=0, R0=0, R5=1, IP=0; frame+20=request, frame+24=6

fields.initializer: 0x3f028/0x3f02a set both domain caps to 0xffffffff if initializer executes

arbitration.direction: M<old ->1; M>old ->0; M==old ->no write; evaluated BEFORE cap
arbitration.auxiliary_policy: 0x3f262..0x3f2ca: even if 12214!=0 and S+8>request, R0=0 rejects R0==1 arm
arbitration.meanings_of_competing_words_and_directio: structural only; hardware units/policy names not established

relay.reload: 0x3f156 reloads effective from core120f0 into private frame+16
relay.api_call: 0x3f11e: R0=M32[core1220c] descriptor; R1=7; R2=&domain; R3=&effective; stack0=&mode
relay.post_return: relay result nonzero skips cache; zero and signed index>=0 stores reloaded frame effective
relay.error_path: 0x3f130 ->0x3f15c log ->0x3f144; pre-call stores are not undone here

conditions: normal selected code and copy mapping; channel1, command6, domain0
logging calls return and preserve carried registers/private frames/selected state and roots
no concurrent or aliased writes to selected words between load/compare/store/reload
no physical data values, clock unit, MMIO effect or success inferred from local arithmetic
helper call is selected even unchanged, but relay gates may reject and callbacks may not return
effective/mode pointers passed to relay may be mutated; post-return cache reload is explicit
